messages: Ben Ortiz: Heads-up: production docs build failed during the mkdocs link checker after the v2 migration. Error references a weird anchor with an encoded space. Ben Ortiz: Log snippet: ```ERROR: Anchor not found: batching-kv%C2%A0cache referenced from /docs/performance/index.html: line 432``` Priya Singh: ugh that looks like a non-breaking space (0xC2 0xA0) got into the heading text when someone pasted from a Google Doc. MkDocs slugify preserves that encoding in the generated anchor. Raj Patel: yep. I saw this with copy-pastes too. Two quick fixes: normalize whitespace in headings (replace NBSP with normal space) or add an explicit HTML anchor above the heading like `` so links keep working. Ben Ortiz: I'm leaning to normalizing whitespace across the repo + a CI check. I'll open a tiny PR to run a grep/replace and add a unit step. Priya Singh: Also we should add a CONTRIBUTING note: "avoid non-standard whitespace in headings" and suggest using the docs editor (not Google Docs) or run `tr '\u00A0' ' '` before commit. Ben Ortiz: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/971 \u2014 replaces NBSP in headings, updates the three broken links, and adds a docs CI job `scripts/ci/normalize-headings.sh` to fail builds if any headings contain control/unusual whitespace. ci-bot: :arrow_up: Running docs CI (build #402) for PR 971... ci-bot: ✖ link-check failed on first run (still found one bad anchor). File: docs/migration/v1-to-v2.md line ~120. Ben Ortiz: Found it. That file had an inline badge right after the heading which inserted a NBSP. I'll push a fix to move the badge below the heading. Priya Singh: small nit: instead of moving badges we can also add `{: .no-anchor}` style? (not supported in mkdocs). Moving is fine. Ben Ortiz: pushed fix. CI re-run. ci-bot: ✅ docs build and link-check passed. Deploying to staging... ci-bot: :white_check_mark: deploy/docs-prod succeeded (build 403). Priya Singh: Verified on prod, links work and migration guide anchor resolves. Thanks Ben :clap: Raj Patel: follow-up: let's add a pre-commit hook that runs `rg "[\u00A0\u2007\u202F]" docs -n` to catch non-standard spaces. File an issue so we don't forget. Ben Ortiz: filed issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/204 "pre-commit: detect NBSP and other nonstandard whitespace in docs headings" docs-bot: label added: docs-maintenance. Priya Singh: I'll add a short blurb to the migration guide advising maintainers to avoid copy/paste from external editors. Ben Ortiz: closing the thread — thanks everyone for quick turnaround.
